baseline_tools.name: get_issue
baseline_tools.description: Get a single issue by its ID, for example TRK-117. Returns the title, status, assignee, body and full comment thread.

candidate_tools.name: get_issue
candidate_tools.description: Get a single issue by its ID, for example TRK-117. Use when you already know the issue ID; use list_issues or search_issues to find issues otherwise. Returns the title, status, assignee, body and full comment thread.

id.description: ID of the issue to retrieve, such as TRK-117.

candidate_tools.name: list_issues
candidate_tools.description: List issues, optionally filtered by status or assignee and capped with limit. Use to browse or filter issues by those fields; use search_issues when you have a text query, and get_issue when you already have an issue ID. Comments are included only when include_comments is true.

include_comments.description: Set true to include comments with the returned issues, which increases response size.

limit.description: Maximum number of issues to return; use a smaller value to keep the response small.

candidate_tools.name: search_issues
candidate_tools.description: Search issues using a text query. Use when you have keywords or a query to find issues; use list_issues to filter by status or assignee, and get_issue when you already have an issue ID. Comments are included only when include_comments is true.

include_comments.description: Set true to include comments with the matching issues, which increases response size.

query.description: Text query used to search for issues.
